capital.evidence_quote: Tbilisi is the capital and largest city of Georgia

currency.evidence_quote: The Georgian Lari (GEL) is the sole legal tender currency in Georgia

timezone.evidence_quote: Georgia operates on Georgia Time UTC+4 year-round without daylight saving adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Residential electricity across Georgia is supplied at 220V single phase

plug_types.evidence_quote: Electrical sockets in Georgia conform to European Type C and grounded Type F Schuko standards

police.evidence_quote: Police emergency assistance throughout Georgia is integrated into unified 112

ambulance.evidence_quote: Emergency medical and ambulance rescue in Georgia connects via 112

fire.evidence_quote: Firefighting emergency dispatch across all Georgian municipalities connects via 112

general.evidence_quote: 112 is the 24/7 unified emergency operations center with multilingual operator capabilities

esim_sim_notes.value: eSIM is supported by Magti and Silknet. Physical tourist SIMs (with unlimited data packages) are readily available at Tbilisi and Batumi airports with simple passport presentation.

festivals.evidence_quote: Tbilisoba celebrating the capital city and Independence Day on May 26 are key national celebrations

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Türk vatandaşları Gürcistan'a yeni çipli kimlik kartıyla pasaportsugirebilir ve 360 gün vizesiz kalabilir. Kilise ziyaretlerinde kadınların başlarını örtmesi ve uzun etek giymesi kuraldır. Rusya üzerinden Abhazya veya Güney Osetya'ya izinsiz girmek Gürcü yasalarına göre suçtur.

sources.title: Consular Department Ministry of Foreign Affairs Georgia

legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Turkish citizens may enter with national biometric ID; church dress code requires covered shoulders and heads
